memo.summary: Context-only committee read: the US has entered a low-confidence Q2 Reflation regime, but the tape is MIXED rather than cleanly risk-on. The most important tension is not the headline caution score itself: that state’s measured 21-session pullback rate is 16.0% versus a 17.8% base rate, so it is an early watch rather than a measured edge. The actionable analytical issue is internal inconsistency—very weak breadth, extreme real yields and rising rate pressure, poor-quality mechanical liquidity expansion, and only 50% cross-asset agreement coexist with calm volatility, tight credit, an above-200-day SPY, and improving leading-cycle data. No signal, trade, ranking, sizing change, or escalation is originated here.
what_fired: Risk Radar moved from calm to caution, led by rates/inflation pressure at 80.3 and breadth internals at 77.3; the radar remains advisory and below-base-rate on its measured 21-day drawdown outcome.
US regime changed from Q3 to Q2 Reflation with confidence only 0.195 and transition state NEW_REGIME.
Breadth is materially weak: 26.0% above the 50-day average, 46.2% above the 200-day average, 40 new lows versus 12 new highs, with breadth divergence present.
Liquidity quantity is expanding, but the expansion is mechanical and classified stress-expansion; the RRP buffer is exhausted and credit stress confirmation is active.
Factor weather is mixed. Quality is the nominal leader, but leader IC is only 0.0042; the factor panel has just 11 dates, history floor is unmet, and factor attention has no graded record.
Pair G factor contradictions did not fire because the ledger remains dormant until at least 60 panel dates.

The spine query was dominated by Canadian-board context claims using unsigned MFE proxies. Those rows are not suitable evidence for directional macro conclusions; multiple terminal states were STOPPED despite positive MFE.

Kernel review shows no engine is armed. Radar is negative overall at 21 and 63 days; alt-data is negative in Q2 at 5 and 21 days; policy, stock-desk, thematic-desk, and narrative-desk families are generally negative or held/vacuous. Positive board-family figures use unsigned MFE proxies and have vacuous or sub-threshold arming tests.
memo.contradictions_review: Current graph tensions are: bonds/FX diverge from the equity regime with only 50% agreement; expanding liquidity conflicts with stress-expansion quality; ticker-level demand and tape readings contain 39 directional divergences; and six buy-lane names have rising put skew, which is de-escalation context only. Several older graph edges still reference Q3 and should not be treated as current-Q2 conclusions without refresh. Master Brain review adds material governance conflicts: growth-over-value underweights face IWF/IWD +5.90% over 20 days; semiconductor underweights face SMH +5.56% over 20 days, an above-200-day trend, and an 86.9th-percentile reading; the China-equity overweight conflicts with Q4 growth-scare, contracting liquidity, and broken China AI-compute leadership. These are attention items, not counter-signals.

Alt-data: Q2 signed excess is negative at both 5 and 21 days; pooled out-of-sample performance is losing.

Stock-desk and thematic-desk: negative longer-horizon estimates across regimes; arming evidence is vacuous or too thin.
Narrative-brain and AI-desk: negative 63-day estimates with no valid arming evidence.
Factor composite: non-tradeable; investment, low-volatility, low-beta, and composite legs have negative IC, while the live panel is immature.
deserves_operator: Review breadth deterioration against narrow technology leadership using the pre-committed recovery/persistence test; do not infer a short signal.
Resolve the liquidity quantity-quality contradiction: mechanical expansion and an empty RRP buffer coexist with stress confirmation.
Require cross-asset confirmation before treating the new, low-confidence Q2 label as settled.
Score or close overdue Master Brain theses. Explicitly reconcile growth and semiconductor underweights with their apparent falsifier conditions and current relative strength.
Review the July 9 China-equity overweight thesis against current Q4/contracting-liquidity/broken-leadership evidence; China market-state freshness is currently insufficient.
Audit stale Q3-labelled contradiction edges after the regime transition so historical graph nodes are not mistaken for current-state evidence.
